title: Production of intonational phrase boundaries in Dutch
why_promising: Primary controlled production from 16 native Dutch speakers; pre-boundary words were manually segmented at the syllable level in Praat, pauses manually segmented when present, and the study supplies production measures for pitch height, final/pre-final duration, and pause duration.
open_question: The paper points to Yoda DOI 10.24416/UU01-K39IB4 but describes data/materials as available on request. Verify whether row-level production data and annotations can actually be downloaded publicly, enumerate files/license, and ingest only if access is genuinely public.
